intersection_7s = set([(7,0), (7,7), (12,0), (12,7)])

# Normalize coordinates to logical space

# For 2s (in cells): need to map to same logical space

# Map physical coordinates to logical cell indices
def phys_to_logical(pos):
    if isinstance(pos, tuple):
        r, c = pos
    else:

    v_idx = min([i for i, d in enumerate(vert_divs) if d >= c])  # Which vertical band
